guidebook.intro: Kiswahili huweka “kama” ndani ya kitenzi (**-ki-**, **-nge-**). Kiingereza hutumia **if** na **when** pamoja na mpangilio maalum wa nyakati.

phrases.target: If it rains, we will stay at home.
If I were rich, I would buy a car.

tips.title: If + sasa, will
body: **-ki-** ni **if** au **when**. Upande wa **if** hutumia wakati uliopo, upande mwingine **will**: **If it rains, we will stay home.** (Mvua ikinyesha, tutakaa nyumbani.)
Usiseme “if it will rain”. **Ukifika, nipigie** ni **When you arrive, call me.**

tips.title: If I were…, I would…
body: Kwa jambo la kufikirika (**-nge-**), Kiingereza hutumia wakati uliopita baada ya **if** na **would** upande mwingine: **If I were rich, I would buy a car.**
Na **be**, tumia **were** kwa kila mtu: **If I were you…** **Laiti** ni **If only…** au **I wish…**: **I wish I had time!**

culture.title: God willing
body: **Mungu akipenda** kwa Kiingereza ni **God willing** au **hopefully**: **See you tomorrow, hopefully!**

stories.title: Ningekuwa tajiri
stories.summary: Wakisubiri matatu, Amani na Juma wanaota watakavyofanya na pesa.

line.speaker: juma
line.target: Amani, if you were rich, what would you do?

line.speaker: amani
line.target: I would build a school in our village.

line.speaker: juma
line.target: I would buy a new matatu, the best of all!
line.base: Mimi ningenunua matatu mpya, nzuri kuliko zote!

line.speaker: amani
line.target: And if it rains, would you give me a free lift?
line.base: Na mvua ikinyesha, ningekupa lifti bure?

line.speaker: juma
line.target: If you pay the fare, yes!
